data.name: Etheline
data.gender_notes: Etheline is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Greek name Aethelflaedh which means 'noble, famous noblewoman'. This name was borne by a 10th-century Anglo-Saxon queen and is derived from the Old English elements ea-thael 'noble' and flaedh 'bright, famous'. It is also associated with the Greek goddess Aethelia, the goddess of eternal flowers. The name Etheline carries the meaning “Eternal Flower” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Etheline usually hope their child will grow to embody eternal flower and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the enduring nature of faith and the eternal beauty of the spirit.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Etheline total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
